title:
Are you looking for a new social activity?
Maybe you would like to learn a new skill?
Or perhaps you already play ukulele and would like to brush up on some techniques and music theory knowledge?

Strike up a chord with Uke Group North CIC, today!

Free taster session and weekly group sessions coming to the Greenmount community next week! 😁

No experience or instrument required!
Running on Mondays from 3rd of June 10:15/11:45!

Sessions also running every Tuesday in Ramsbottom at Ramsbottom Library and Rammy Men's, The Den Community Hub on Stubbins Vale Road.

Get in touch to book: ukegroupnorth@gmail.com

Please share, Thank you!
